v21.notes: Made from the stock rk3326-r35s-linux.dtb with the native-mode fix. Default mode clock=29000 vertical=480,165,2,14 (~60 Hz).

v20.notes: Website generator, R36S Clone, from the DTB scanned off the stock card. 151 init commands, speaker amp + headphone detect included. Default 30 MHz, ~80 Hz (factory).

soysauce.notes: Generator with R36S Soysauce, then flags changed 0xe03 -> 0xa03 (continuous clock) to stop bleeding. Only that one byte differs from before-fix/.
